_comment: Per-crate line coverage floors (%), checked by scripts/check-coverage.py. Each floor is the crate's coverage measured on CI run 37050928687 (coverage job 110983844454), rounded down, minus a 1-point margin for run-to-run jitter and small PRs. Ratchet: raise a floor when coverage rises. Crates not listed use 'default'. Changed-line coverage of a PR is printed for review only.
